blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Three x squared plus five x minus x squared plus two x.
The x squared terms are three x squared and negative x squared, which has a coefficient of negative one. Three minus one is two, so two x squared.
The x terms are five x and two x. Five plus two is seven, so seven x. x squared and x are not like terms, so we stop here.
So the answer is two x squared plus seven x.
Watch out for these traps. If you combine the x squared terms with the x terms, you get nine x squared. If you forget the minus in front of x squared, you get four x squared plus seven x.
